name: WebLINX
summary: McGill NLP Apache-2.0 benchmark for real-world website navigation with multi-turn dialogue (ICML 2024 Spotlight), also runnable through BrowserGym.
description: Academic listing (McGill NLP). The McGill-NLP/weblinx repository is Apache-2.0, not archived. Website https://mcgill-nlp.github.io/weblinx/ (HTTP 200; the no-trailing-slash URL 301s there and is not used). Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05930. Hugging Face dataset https://huggingface.co/datasets/McGill-NLP/WebLINX. The README describes conversational web navigation with multi-turn dialogue and notes that WebLINX is now available as a benchmark through BrowserGym (ServiceNow/BrowserGym), alongside environments such as WebArena. The pack is free under Apache-2.0. Documented eval, Colab and BrowserGym runs were not executed.

agent_access.notes: Public Apache-2.0 benchmark, dataset and website. Documented eval, Colab and BrowserGym commands were not executed. This entry does not set mcp_endpoint. No signup or spend.
